problem:
$n$ is negative **or** greater than $10,$ **and** $n$ is odd.

Express the compound predicate above in symbolic form given the following notations:

- $N(n):$ $n$ is negative

- $G(n):$ $n$ is greater than $10,$

- $O(n):$ $n$ is odd

feedback.problem:
$x$ is positive, **and** $x$ is irrational **or** integer.

Express the compound predicate above in symbolic form given the following notations:

- $P(x):$ $x$ is positive

- $Q(x):$ $x$ is irrational

- $R(x):$ $x$ is integer
feedback.worked_solution:
The word "and" is represented by the symbol "$∧,$" while the word "or" is represented by the symbol "$∨.$"

Note that this sentence consists of two parts:

- **Part 1:** $x$ is positive. This corresponds to $P.$

- **Part 2:** $x$ is irrational or integer. This corresponds to

$$
{{x\text{ is irrational}}_{⏟}}_{Q}\,{{\text{or}}_{⏟}}_{∨}\,{{x\text{ is integer}}_{⏟}}_{R},
$$

that is, $Q∨R.$

So, we can express the sentence as

$$
{{x\text{ is positive}}_{⏟}}_{P}\,{{\text{and}}_{⏟}}_{∧}\,{{x\text{ is irrational}\text{ or integer}}_{⏟}}_{Q\,∨\,R},
$$

that is, $P∧(Q∨R).$
